text: ひとを　しんじこませるのが　うまい。

structure.jp: ひとを　しんじこませるのが

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せる ending means 'make someone do it'. ひとを　しんじこませる = 'make people believe completely'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing'. しんじこませるの = 'making people believe'.

patterns.name: 〜がうまい
patterns.span: しんじこませるのが　うまい
patterns.explanation: が うまい says someone is skilled at the thing before が. しんじこませるのが　うまい = 'is good at making people believe'.
